name: Staff millwright lever (samples failed_bakes_and_broken_boxes: failed pool image bakes plus boxes with a broken resolv.conf, a full /tmp or a stale bin; at level act, re-runs a failed bake once per bake id)

knobs.note: BH-10124 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock, only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only all-digit values. NOT settable from the control plane. The level and the re-run cap are settings rows (staff.millwright.level, staff.millwright.bake_rerun_max_day); the read knobs are lib rows (lib.staff-millwright.*), not lane knobs.
BH-10124 test seam: 1 = load mwl_action_verdict and return before the run. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/staff/millwright-lever.sh honors MWL_NOW and MW_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
